definitions.above_ma20_breadth: fraction of PIT members with close_t > MA20_t
definitions.above_ma60_breadth: fraction of PIT members with close_t > MA60_t
definitions.b60_breakout_breadth: fraction with close_t > max(close_(t-60)..close_(t-1)); current day excluded
definitions.cross_sectional_median_20d_return: median of close_t / close_(t-20) - 1 over valid PIT members
definitions.cross_sectional_median_close_vs_ma20: median of close_t / MA20_t - 1 over valid PIT members

coverage: Every denominator is the exact PIT member count; values are INVALID_COVERAGE when valid_count / PIT_MEMBER_COUNT < 95%.
